subject: RE: Model regression after v2.3.1 rollout - request to pin/rollback
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@retailco.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-05T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: RetailCo discovery + model recommendations

Hi Alex - great to meet today. Quick recap from our call and next steps: 

- Summary: RetailCo is focused on QA/assisted-summarization for product reviews (~2M monthly requests, 99th pct latency target 800ms).
- Recommended models: start with rwd-7b-quant (low-cost), use rwd-13b-ft for higher accuracy in evaluations; we also recommend pinning to v2.2.9 for the initial rollout.
- Evals: attached is the benchmark CSV comparing v2.3.1 vs v2.2.9 on your prompt set; prompt samples are in prompt-set-retailco.txt.

Next steps:
1) Your team to review the prompt set and call out any missing intents (Alex).
2) We'll run a full A/B eval across a 10k sample and share results (Marissa/Rishi).
3) If you want, we can pin your Dedicated pool to v2.2.9 while we continue evaluations of v2.3.x (you'll keep the same endpoint, we manage the pin).

I've attached the quick evaluation CSV and the prompt set used during the call. If RetailCo is comfortable, we can pin today to avoid any risk from the latest rollout.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- eval-results-v2.3.1-v2.2.9.csv (summary of automated metrics + sample diffs)
- prompt-set-retailco.txt (10 sample prompts used in call)

From: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@retailco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-05T18:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: RetailCo discovery + model recommendations

Marissa - thanks for the recap and the files. Quick note: we already flipped our staging endpoint to v2.3.1 this morning to test throughput and we're seeing a measurable drop in summary quality on a subset of edge-cases (negations and multi-product threads). I attached two examples inline below.

Example 1 (input): "I don't recommend the charger, but the headphones were fine."
v2.2.9 output: "Mentions headphones positive; charger negative."
v2.3.1 output: "Mentions headphones positive and recommends the charger."

Example 2 (input): "Bought two laptops - one returned due to screen issue, one kept."
v2.2.9 output: "One returned due to screen; one retained."
v2.3.1 output: "Customer returned both laptops."

This is impacting a small but critical portion of our benchmarks. Would appreciate if you can pause v2.3.1 for RetailCo (pin to v2.2.9) until we validate. Procurement is cc'd for any formal approval.

Cheers,
Alex
Head of ML Products | RetailCo
alex.nguyen@retailco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@retailco.com>, Procurement <procurement@retailco.com>
Date: 2027-09-05T19:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Follow-up: RetailCo discovery + model recommendations - urgent regression reported

Team - FYI forwarding RetailCo's note. They report quality regressions on v2.3.1 for negations/multi-entity threads after their quick smoke tests. They asked to pin to v2.2.9 immediately.

Can you please: 
- Rishi: confirm whether this is expected behavior from the v2.3.1 change (attention tweak + new tokenization) and whether a quick diff/trouble ticket captures this.
- Neha: validate rollback/pin process for Dedicated accounts (RetailCo is on a reserved Dedicated pool) and ETA for pin.

I've attached the eval CSV we used in the call; it shows a small but clear drop in exact-match on certain prompts. Alex - we'll get back with timing within the hour.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments:
- eval-results-v2.3.1-v2.2.9.csv

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@retailco.com>, Procurement <procurement@retailco.com>
Date: 2027-09-05T20:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Follow-up: RetailCo discovery + model recommendations - urgent regression reported

Hey all - brief technical note and action plan: 

1) Root cause (quick take): the v2.3.1 release includes a tokenization edge patch and a minor attention-scaling change that can flip behavior on rare negation constructions. The team has a ticket (INF-11872) to track regression examples.

2) Immediate mitigation options for RetailCo (choose one):
   a) Pin Dedicated pool to v2.2.9 (fast, non-disruptive, TTL-based pin we apply to the account). ETA: ~30-45 minutes to deploy and validate.
   b) Roll forward fix in v2.3.2 with targeted tokenizer patch - ETA: 3-5 business days for validation and rollout.

3) We can also run a focused A/B using the 10k sample from Marissa's eval to measure the delta across the problem buckets; that will take ~4 hours.

Recommendation: pin to v2.2.9 for RetailCo now, run 10k A/B, and then either unpin after v2.3.2 or keep pin if metrics prefer 2.2.9.

I'll own the INF ticket and coordinate with runtime for the pin. Marissa - please confirm sign-off from Alex/procurement and I'll schedule the pin.

-Rishi
Director, Inference Reliability | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@retailco.com>, Procurement <procurement@retailco.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-06T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Model regression after v2.3.1 rollout - request to pin/rollback

Alex / Procurement - thanks for flagging these examples. Per Rishi's note, we can pin your Dedicated pool to v2.2.9 immediately (option a).

Proposed next steps and ask: 
- Action: Redwood to pin RetailCo Dedicated pool to v2.2.9 within the next 45 minutes and run a smoke-validation across the prompt-set-retailco.txt.
- Evaluation: We will run the 10k A/B in parallel and share the dashboard link (Drive folder) with detailed diffs.
- Credit: Given impact, Redwood will apply a one-week usage credit for any degraded requests during investigation (we'll reflect in the next invoice).

Please reply to this thread with a one-line approval to proceed with the pin. If Procurement prefers a formal DocuSign/PO, let us know and we'll pause until that's in place - otherwise we can proceed on Alex's approval.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
